decisive_items: hypodense lesion was noted in the middle ear
fistula originating from the middle ear
2-centimeter mass found during drilling of the hypoplastic petrous bone
response.rationale: Cholesteatoma is supported by middle ear hypodensity, fistula from middle ear, and surgical mass; recurrent cellulitis and discharge fit its erosive/infective complications. OMS-associated infection is too generic, and osteomyelitis lacks the discrete mass and middle ear origin.

rejected.why: Describes the underlying syndrome and cellulitis but not the specific middle ear mass/fistula that defines the lesion.
Imaging hyperintensity at petrous edge is nonspecific and contradicted by surgical finding of a discrete mass rather than diffuse bone infection.
